name: tracking-proof-support-resilience
objective: Verify and close Captain tracking/PoD/support/rescue/recovery gaps, including convergence of parallel support/chat routes, while preserving DSH ownership and privacy.
truthOwner: DSH owns delivery/status/location-reference/support/incident/rescue operational truth; media owns governed proof assets; WLT is visibility-only from rescue.

tasks.objective: Prove active task location status and PoD recovery
tasks.currentProblem: Current Captain runtime has location/status/PoD paths, but static wiring does not prove assignment isolation, OS lifecycle, weak-network unknown-result recovery, proof/media binding, tracking freshness or legal state progression.
tasks.requiredChange: Run current runtime and backend evidence first; reproduce any illegal/fabricated/stale transition. Fix only the authoritative DSH/media/runtime owner and preserve foreground-only behavior unless current Product Truth explicitly requires background tracking.
tasks.targetState: Location, status and PoD are assignment-scoped, retry-safe and canonically read back; refresh/restart/offline failure cannot fabricate completion and protected data remains bounded.
tasks.action: Trace active assignment runtime through location/status/PoD APIs, DSH routes/persistence/media and client/operator readback; execute current tests; add/fix only missing negative cases proven by evidence; rerun on final unit candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not add background tracking solely because foreground-only code exists.
Do not persist unnecessary location history locally.
Do not mark delivery/PoD successful from uncertain client-local state.
acceptanceCriteria: Location and PoD mutations reject wrong/stale assignment identity and remain duplicate-safe.
Canonical readback survives refresh/restart and never fabricates success after unknown network result.
Client/operator see role-appropriate current tracking/proof without internal Captain/private details.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused authoritative-owner fix; never restore a local success flag or unscoped location/proof path.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused tracking/PoD change set after reproduced failure and affected runtime/backend checks pass.

tasks.objective: Converge Captain support chat incident and rescue on one governed path
tasks.currentProblem: Current code exposes a disabled orderchat route while support routing exposes live chat-read-ack/chat-send through CaptainOrderSupportConversationScreen; support Product Truth also requires assigned-order ownership, internal-note isolation, conflict/idempotency and operator-owned rescue.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace route registry/navigation and support API/backend/database/operator readback; decide which chat route is canonical, route live entry points through it, remove or delegate obsolete parallel behavior when safe, and repair only proven ownership/conflict/audit/retry gaps.
tasks.targetState: Captain has one governed assigned-order support conversation path; no dead/parallel truth, cross-order access, internal-note leak, local rescue state or DSH financial mutation remains.
tasks.action: Map orderchat, chat-read-ack, chat-send, route registry and navigation callers; exercise assigned/unassigned order cases and operator readback; implement root-cause convergence rather than copy-only patches; rerun support/backend/app-captain checks.
mustNotChange: Do not expose internal operator notes to Captain.
Do not let Captain mutate rescue state.
Do not mutate WLT ledger/balance/refund/settlement from DSH rescue.
Do not keep two independently behaving Captain chat/support truths.
acceptanceCriteria: Every live Captain chat/support entry point resolves to one governed support conversation model or an explicitly non-live alias.
Captain cannot create/read support for an unassigned order and cannot see internal notes.
Conflict/retry returns canonical state and operator rescue/audit readback remains authoritative.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused route/support convergence commit if regressions appear; do not restore a duplicate local support truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused support/route-convergence commit separate from unrelated tracking or financial work.
